title: dufrenoya heterantha
intro: Dufrenoya heterantha, commonly known as the 'Sangre de Toro' or 'Ox's Blood', is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central America. The health benefits of Dufrenoya heterantha include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal agent, which may help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which may have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. However, further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of Dufrenoya heterantha.
